newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnian Serb defence council backs Mladic sacking.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian Serb defence council backs Mladic sacking.

text.p: The Bosnian Serb defence council, a political rather than military body, has endorsed Major General Pero Colic's appointment as the new military chief replacing General Ratko Mladic, SRNA reported on Saturday.

Earlier, Bosnian Serb president Biljana Plavsic announced she had dismissed Mladic -- indicted for war crimes by the International War Crimes Tribunal in The Hague -- as part of a reorganisation of the army command.
The Bosnian Serb news agency quoted the Supreme Defence Council as saying it backed Plavsic's decision to appoint Colic, and Major General Dragan Josipovic as his deputy.
The Council is made up of the Serb political leadership as well as military representatives, but analysts say it does not reflect the opinions of the military command.
